meaning: An old printer that makes letters from tiny dots. Little pins hit an inked ribbon against the paper.
clues: It is noisy, because it hits the paper to print.
The paper had little holes along both edges.
Pins in the print head pushed an inked ribbon against the page.
Because it hit the paper, it could print on several layers at once.
It has three words. The last is a machine that prints, and the first starts with D.
assumes: An inkjet printer sprays tiny drops of ink
A laser printer uses toner powder
A thermal printer uses heat on special paper

decoys.meaning: A printer that sprays tiny drops of ink onto paper.
A printer that uses a laser and a powder called toner.
A printer that uses heat on special paper, as many store receipts do.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: That zzzzzt-zzzzzt sound meant a report was coming. You could hear it from three rooms away.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Today's version: a laser or inkjet printer, or just a PDF sent by email. Tip: print only what you really need.
